description: This file defines the class AOR_Condition, which extends Basic, representing a condition entity in the SuiteCRM/AOR module. It contains properties describing database schema details, and a method 'save_lines' for processing and saving condition lines from POST data, including handling for deletions, serialization, and various data transformations.

classes.name: AOR_Condition
classes.description: Represents a condition that can be used within report or workflow logic; includes properties for schema details and a method to save condition lines.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Processes POST data to save multiple condition lines, handling deletions, data serialization, and setting appropriate properties.
